Newest first.
Current State: Gitboard operates as a local dashboard for GitLab and GitHub, integrating with `gh`, `glab`, and `git` to provide real-time visibility into CI status, open Merge Requests, and local worktree states.
Deployment Model: The tool is distributed as a compiled binary, initialized via `gitboard init` and synchronized through `gitboard sync` to serve a local web interface at `http://127.0.0.1:1325/`.
